blocks.prompt: 6. If the 4th and 9th term of a G.P. are 54 and 13122 respectively. Find the G.P. Also find its general term.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein G.P. ke beech ke do terms diye gaye hain aur humein poori G.P. wapas banani hai.
Diya kya hai? \(a_4 = 54\), \(a_9 = 13122\).
Find kya karna hai? \(a_1\) aur \(r\), phir G.P. aur general term \(a_n\).
Plan: dono terms ko formula se likhenge, ek equation ko doosri se divide karenge taake \(a_1\) cancel ho jaye, phir \(r\) aur \(a_1\) nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_4 = 54\), \(a_9 = 13122\).
Humein find karna hai: G.P. aur us ka general term.
Tareeqa: Har diya hua term \(a_1\) aur \(r\) mein ek equation deta hai. Do unknowns aur do equations hain. G.P. mein equations ko divide karna sab se aasaan hai, kyunke \(a_1\) foran cancel ho jata hai.

Dono equations likhein
\[a_1 r^{3} = 54 \quad (1)\]
\[a_1 r^{8} = 13122 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: \(a_n = a_1 r^{n-1}\) mein \(n = 4\) rakhein to power 3, aur \(n = 9\) rakhein to power 8 aati hai.

(2) ko (1) se divide karein
\[\dfrac{a_1 r^{8}}{a_1 r^{3}} = \dfrac{13122}{54}\]
\[r^{5} = 243 = 3^{5}\]
\[r = 3\]
Kyun: Upar neeche \(a_1\) cancel ho gaya, aur ek hi base ki powers divide karne par minus hoti hain: \(8 - 3 = 5\). \(13122 \div 54 = 243\), aur \(243 = 3 \times 3 \times 3 \times 3 \times 3 = 3^5\). Odd power (5) ka real root sirf ek hota hai, is liye \(r = 3\).
Dhyan dein: Equations ko minus nahi, divide karna hai; minus karne se \(a_1\) cancel nahi hota.

(1) se \(a_1\) nikalein
\[a_1 (3)^3 = 54\]
\[27 a_1 = 54 \Rightarrow a_1 = 2\]
Kyun: Ab \(r\) maloom hai, to usay kisi bhi equation mein wapas rakh sakte hain. (1) chhoti hai, is liye usay chuna. \(3^3 = 27\) aur \(54 \div 27 = 2\).

G.P. aur general term likhein
\[2, 6, 18, 54, \ldots\]
\[a_n = 2 \cdot 3^{n-1}\]
Kyun: Pehla term 2 hai aur har dafa 3 se multiply karte hain. General term ka matlab hai woh formula jo kisi bhi \(n\) ke liye term de de; is liye \(a_1 = 2\) aur \(r = 3\) ko \(a_n = a_1 r^{n-1}\) mein rakh diya.

Tasdeeq
\[a_4 = 2 \cdot 3^3 = 54\ \checkmark\]
\[a_9 = 2 \cdot 3^8 = 2 \cdot 6561 = 13122\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: Hamare formula ne dono diye hue terms bilkul wapas de diye, is liye \(a_1 = 2\), \(r = 3\) sahi hain.
